candidates.title: BJA FY 2026 Second Chance Act Improving Reentry Education and Employment Outcomes
candidates.funder: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance
why_fit: Directly supports education, vocational/trade training, workforce development, job readiness, employment attainment and retention for adults and youth leaving prison and jail.
Closely matches Broken Growth Ministries' reentry, job placement, trade-skills training and post-release stabilization model.
candidates.eligibility_note: BJA describes the program as supporting state, local and tribal governments and community-based organizations. Confirm applicant-type language in the current FY2026 NOFO before treating Broken Growth Ministries as a direct applicant; otherwise pursue a government/eligible lead partnership.
needs_user: Confirm current IRS 501(c)(3) determination status or fiscal-sponsor route if required by the NOFO.
Confirm proposed correctional/jail partner and access for pre-release programming.
Confirm project budget, match/cost share if any, staffing commitments, partner commitments and outcome targets.

candidates.title: BJA FY 2026 Smart Reentry Demonstration Program
candidates.funder: U.S. Department of Justice, Bureau of Justice Assistance
why_fit: Funds comprehensive reentry strategies and interventions intended to reduce recidivism for people returning from adult correctional facilities.
Broken Growth Ministries could be a strong service/subrecipient partner for housing, employment, mentorship, transportation and stabilization components.
candidates.eligibility_note: Current official and Grants.gov-derived listings identify state, local, tribal and other units of government as the primary eligible applicants. Treat Broken Growth Ministries as a prospective subrecipient/implementation partner unless the current NOFO expressly provides another direct route.
needs_user: Identify/authorize outreach to an eligible lead such as Escambia County, City of Pensacola, Florida Department of Corrections or another qualifying jurisdiction.
Confirm any cash/in-kind match commitment only after the NOFO and partner budget are reviewed.
Do not make any partnership, match or financial commitment without human approval.

candidates.title: Volunteer Generation Fund Grant Year 2026-2027
why_fit: Supports Florida-based nonprofits, faith-based/community organizations and partnerships that mobilize volunteers.
The published NOFO expressly allows an established 501(c)(3) fiscal agent to accept donations for a group without IRS tax-exempt status.
Could strengthen volunteer recruitment and service capacity for outreach, reentry support, food/clothing distribution, mentoring and housing-support operations.
needs_user: Confirm whether Broken Growth Ministries has its IRS determination letter by application date; if not, select an eligible fiscal agent.
Confirm a lawful, documented 50% match source; do not invent or pledge match funds.
Confirm proposed volunteer targets and service activities.
